# webbpulse_registry_module (Resource)

A private module in the registry, connected to a GitHub repository like `tfe_registry_module` with `vcs_repo`. Each `vX.Y.Z` or `X.Y.Z` tag pushed to the repository publishes that version. Versions publish in the background, so read them with the `webbpulse_registry_module` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "webbpulse_registry_module" "network" {
  vcs_repo {
    identifier = "WebbPulse/terraform-aws-network"
  }
}

resource "webbpulse_registry_module" "named" {
  name            = "baseline"
  module_provider = "aws"
  import_tags     = true

  resync_triggers = {
    round = "1"
  }

  vcs_repo {
    identifier = "WebbPulse/infra-modules"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `import_tags` (Boolean) Whether connecting imports the repository's existing semantic version tags. Read only on create, so changing it later does nothing. Defaults to `true`.
- `module_provider` (String) The module's provider, the third part of its address. Defaults to `<provider>` from a repository named `terraform-<provider>-<name>`, and is required for any other repository. Changing it replaces the module.
- `name` (String) The module name. Defaults to `<name>` from a repository named `terraform-<provider>-<name>`, and is required for any other repository. Changing it replaces the module.
- `resync_triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values whose change queues an import of every semantic version tag in the repository, in place. Picks up tags GitHub sent no push event for. Published versions are left alone.
- `vcs_repo` (Block, Optional) The GitHub repository the module publishes from, through the environment's GitHub App. Required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vcs_repo))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the module was connected.
- `id` (String) The module address, `namespace/name/provider`.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace, which is the repository owner.
- `source` (String) The address a module block's `source` names after the registry host, such as `WebbPulse/network/aws`.

<a id="nestedblock--vcs_repo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcs_repo`

Optional:

- `identifier` (String) The repository as `owner/name`. The owner becomes the namespace. The environment's GitHub App has to be installed on it, or the apply fails with `VCS_REPO_NOT_INSTALLED`. Changing it replaces the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import webbpulse_registry_module.network WebbPulse/network/aws
```
